name: heartRateIntraday
description: Heart rate through the day aggregated into fixed time windows, with average, minimum and maximum beats per minute

range.startTime: {{new Date(new Date(timeframe.end).getTime()-new Date(timeframe.start).getTime()<=90000000 ? new Date(new Date(timeframe.end).getTime()-1).toISOString().slice(0,10) : timeframe.start).toISOString()}}
range.endTime: {{new Date(new Date(timeframe.end).getTime()-new Date(timeframe.start).getTime()<=90000000 ? new Date(new Date(new Date(timeframe.end).getTime()-1).toISOString().slice(0,10)).getTime()+86400000 : timeframe.end).toISOString()}}
